stemMd: A clock gains 2 minutes every real hour. It is correct at noon. What time will it show after 6 real hours?
explanationMd: Six real hours after noon is 6:00 p.m. The clock has gained 6 × 2 = 12 minutes, so it reads 6:12 p.m. Add accumulated error to the true time because the clock gains.

distractorRationale.c: This includes only one hour of gain.
distractorRationale.b: This treats a gaining clock as losing time.
distractorRationale.a: This gains only one minute per hour.
distractorRationale.d: This uses too many hours of accumulated gain.
